labelOrigin: Agent-drafted from reading the code at the pinned commit (CLA-289); pending Brenton's spot-check before counting as ground truth.

questions.question: When I share a drawing as a link, how is it kept private from the server that stores it?
questions.answerNote: exportToBackend generates a fresh AES-GCM key, compresses+encrypts the serialized scene and POSTs only ciphertext to the json backend; the returned id and the key go in the URL hash (#json=<id>,<key>), which browsers never send to the server. Images are encrypted and stored in Firebase under /files/shareLinks/<id>.

questions.question: When two people edit the same shape at the same time in a live session, whose change wins?
questions.answerNote: Remote scene updates are decrypted and passed through reconcileElements: the local copy is kept if it is being edited/resized/created locally or has a higher version; on equal versions the lower versionNonce wins deterministically; otherwise the remote element replaces it.

questions.question: Where does my drawing get saved when I close the tab without exporting, and how often?
questions.answerNote: LocalData.save is debounced (SAVE_TO_LOCAL_STORAGE_TIMEOUT = 300ms): elements and cleaned appState go to localStorage, image files go to IndexedDB (idb-keyval) via a LocalFileManager; saving is paused while collaborating, and quota-exceeded is surfaced via an atom.

questions.question: How does undo work, and why doesn't it roll back what a collaborator just drew?
questions.answerNote: History keeps undo/redo stacks of HistoryDelta entries recorded only from local durable store increments; undo/redo apply the inverse delta to current elements/appState, excluding version/versionNonce so each undo produces a new version for collaborators. Remote changes are never recorded, so they are not undone.

questions.question: What gives shapes their wobbly hand-drawn look, and why doesn't the wobble change every time the screen redraws?
questions.answerNote: Shapes are generated with roughjs's RoughGenerator; generateRoughOptions passes the element's stored seed (plus roughness adjusted for size, stroke style, fill weight), so the same element always produces the same jitter.

questions.question: Why doesn't a language appear in the language picker even though someone has started translating it?
questions.answerNote: Translations come from Crowdin (crowdin.yml maps locales/en.json to locales/<locale>.json); i18n.ts only lists languages whose completion in locales/percentages.json is >= COMPLETION_THRESHOLD (85%), falling back to en.json for missing keys.

questions.question: How do I put the whiteboard inside my own React app, and what do I do about fonts if I host everything myself?
questions.answerNote: Install react, react-dom and @excalidraw/excalidraw; fonts load from a CDN by default, so for self-hosting copy dist/prod/fonts into your public assets and set window.EXCALIDRAW_ASSET_PATH; the container must have non-zero width/height.

questions.question: Which outside services does the hosted app talk to for share links and live sessions, and where is that set?
questions.answerNote: .env.production sets VITE_APP_BACKEND_V2_GET/POST_URL (json.excalidraw.com share storage), VITE_APP_WS_SERVER_URL (collab socket.io server), Firebase config (files/room persistence), library and AI backends; Collab.tsx opens the socket.io connection to the WS server URL.

questions.question: Is there a shared helper that limits how often something runs to at most once per screen frame?
questions.answerNote: throttleRAF in @excalidraw/common utils schedules the wrapped function with window.requestAnimationFrame, keeping only the latest args, with flush/cancel; the same file also has debounce.

c4Note.note: The whole yarn-workspaces monorepo collapses into one container named after the root package with 523 flat file components, so the fundamental split the repo's own CLAUDE.md describes — the excalidraw.com web app vs the @excalidraw/excalidraw React library vs supporting packages (element, common, math, utils) — is lost. Examples and the dev-docs site are mixed in. The services the app depends on (share-link JSON backend, collab socket server, Firebase) are not modelled.
expectedContainers: external: json.excalidraw.com share backend, collab socket.io server, Firebase
problems: package.json 'workspaces' (excalidraw-app, packages/*, examples/*) ignored: everything collapsed into container:excalidraw-monorepo
523 one-file components with no grouping (372 of them from packages/excalidraw)
examples/* and dev-docs/src mixed into the same container as the product
no external systems for the JSON share backend, socket collab server or Firebase configured in .env.production

overviews.note: Summary says it is the Excalidraw editor monorepo and its layers; key points name the element union and mutation funnel; children is one collapsed container.
Summary and key points give the entry files and store/undo seam; 523 children starting with dev-docs/examples is noise, so it goes last; parent redundant.
